entries.name: Excel MCP server (live COM, .NET) — Click-to-Run / Microsoft 365
entries.summary: Automate Microsoft Excel through its native COM API — Power Query, DAX measures, PivotTables, charts, formatting, and VBA macros (25 tools / ~230 operations) with real recalc against the live Excel process. Community server sbroenne/mcp-server-excel (C#/.NET 10), pinned to release v1.8.70. Distributed as a self-contained mcp-excel.exe — download from the release ZIP and add to PATH (see vendored_source.install_cmd); the launch command is the bare `mcp-excel` binary, not uvx. disabled-until-probe: enables only when Excel AND the mcp-excel server binary are present. PROBE SCOPE: this row targets a Click-to-Run / Microsoft 365 Excel install (the C:\Program Files*\Microsoft Office\root\Office1?\EXCEL.EXE layout, where the `root\` segment is the Click-to-Run signature). MSI / volume-license installs lay EXCEL.EXE down WITHOUT the `root\` segment (…\Microsoft Office\Office16\EXCEL.EXE), so the host-detect probe does NOT cover them in this batch — filepath.Glob has no `**` and the install_probe uses AND-semantics across entries, so it cannot OR the optional `root\` across two patterns. A file_globs[] OR-group probe model covering Click-to-Run + MSI + macOS is the tracked D-3 follow-up. The VBA-exec / RunMacro operations execute arbitrary code in the live workbook — gate the 6 VBA-exec ops behind operator consent (D-4). Windows + Click-to-Run Excel desktop only.

vendored_source.install_cmd: download mcp-excel.exe from the v1.8.70 release ZIP (https://github.com/sbroenne/mcp-server-excel/releases/tag/v1.8.70), extract to a tools dir, and add that dir to PATH

entries.name: Ableton Live MCP (extended)
entries.summary: Control Ableton Live over a local TCP socket — create/edit tracks, clips, devices, and transport via the Live Object Model. Installed from mcphub's build-fixed fork applicate2628/ableton-mcp-extended (a fork of the community server uisato/ableton-mcp-extended, itself a more-capable fork of ahujasid/ableton-mcp), pinned to the immutable fix commit da886bf94a256efcd51785031217b1071fc68871 and installed/run via uvx from that git source. WHY THE FORK: upstream uisato's pyproject mis-declared the optional `AbletonMCP_UDP` package at the wrong path, so setuptools' source build failed and `uvx --from git+...uisato...` could not install; our fork drops `AbletonMCP_UDP` from `packages` (verified not imported by MCP_Server/server.py — it is an optional separate UDP add-on), and the install now builds (empirically verified: uvx resolves 44 packages and the server starts, correctly reporting the Remote-Script requirement). The console-script entry point `ableton-mcp-extended = "MCP_Server.server:main"` is unchanged from upstream. Do NOT use the PyPI name `ableton-mcp-extended` — that is a DIFFERENT codebase (IMNMV's Claude-session branch) that depends on the nonexistent `audio2llm` PyPI package and fails to install; same name, different project. disabled-until-probe: enables only when a SUPPORTED Ableton Live is installed. REQUIRES Ableton Live 11 or newer — the extended fork's README advertises Live 11+ and does NOT support Live 10 or earlier; the install probe therefore narrows to Live 11-19 (and Live 20+ when released) via the glob C:\ProgramData\Ableton\Live 1[1-9]*\Program\Ableton Live 1[1-9]*.exe (the 1[1-9] char-class matches Live 11-19 across all editions Suite/Standard/Intro/Lite and EXCLUDES Live 10, whose third version digit 0 is outside 1-9), so a Live-10-only host does not falsely pass admission for a server it cannot drive; macOS (/Applications/Ableton Live *.app) is NOT covered in this batch — the install_probe uses AND-semantics across entries and cannot OR a second install root, so a macOS row (or file_globs[] OR-group support) is a follow-up. SETUP (operator-side, REQUIRED): install the bundled Ableton Remote Script into Live's User Library Remote Scripts directory and load it as a Control Surface in Live — the MCP server connects to that script over a local TCP socket on localhost:9877; the host-exe probe detects Live, NOT the Remote Script, so verify the script is loaded before use. The fork's runtime deps (mcp[cli]>=1.3.0, elevenlabs>=0.2.26, python-dotenv>=1.0.0) ALL resolve cleanly on PyPI — it bundles ElevenLabs voice integration that installs via the dep, but the VOICE tools need an ElevenLabs API key while the core Ableton control works WITHOUT any key. The high-performance UDP hybrid server is an optional manual add-on, not the default. PRIVACY: the source carries no telemetry — there is no telemetry to disable, so no opt-out env is set on this row (unlike the prior ahujasid row, which set ABLETON_MCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY). LICENSE: MIT, inherited from upstream uisato.

entries.name: Codex MCP server (OpenAI Codex CLI)
entries.summary: Expose the OpenAI Codex CLI as an MCP server (`codex mcp-server`, stdio) so agents can call codex as a tool (codex() / codex-reply()). Official Codex CLI subcommand — NOT a community fork, so no vendored_source/pin. disabled-until-probe: enables only when the `codex` binary is on PATH. Keep the direct invoke-codex-prompt.sh path for orchestration/commission (file-based, governance); this row is for agents calling codex-as-tool.

entries.name: MATLAB MCP server (official, MathWorks)
entries.summary: Run MATLAB from an AI client — execute code, scripts, and functions against a live MATLAB process via the official MathWorks Go MCP server (matlab-mcp-server, stdio). OFFICIAL MathWorks server (matlab/matlab-mcp-server, pinned to release v0.11.0) — NOT a community fork, so no vendored_source (like the codex row). Distributed as a self-contained matlab-mcp-server binary: download matlab-mcp-server-windows-x64.exe from the v0.11.0 release and add it to PATH (rename to matlab-mcp-server), OR `go install github.com/matlab/matlab-mcp-server/cmd/matlab-mcp-server@latest`. REQUIRES a host MATLAB R2021a-or-later install ON THE SYSTEM PATH — by default the server finds the first MATLAB on PATH (it can also be pointed at one via --matlab-root / the MW_MCP_SERVER_MATLAB_ROOT env var, but this row sets no args/env so PATH is the only discovery), then drives the live MATLAB engine, so executing MATLAB code runs arbitrary host computation; the operator gates that the same way they gate any code-exec tool. disabled-until-probe: enables only when BOTH the matlab-mcp-server binary AND the `matlab` launcher are on PATH — the probe (binaries: matlab-mcp-server + matlab) AGREES with the server's own PATH discovery, so a MATLAB installed but NOT on PATH does not falsely enable the row. If you keep MATLAB off PATH, pass --matlab-root=<MATLAB root> (or set MW_MCP_SERVER_MATLAB_ROOT) in the manifest after install. License: MathWorks custom (BSD-style, with a clause restricting use to MathWorks products).

entries.name: Ansys MAPDL MCP server (PyMAPDL)
entries.summary: Drive Ansys MAPDL (Mechanical APDL) from an AI client through PyMAPDL — launch/connect to a MAPDL session and run finite-element analysis. Official Ansys server ansys/pymapdl-mcp (Python, FastMCP, stdio), pinned to release v0.2.1; published on PyPI as ansys-mapdl-mcp, run via uvx with the version pinned in args (like serena's pinned uvx source), so no vendored_source (official Ansys-org package, Apache-2.0). disabled-until-probe: enables only when an Ansys MAPDL install is detected via the version-agnostic glob C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v*\ansys\bin\winx64\ansys*.exe — the Ansys solver executable is itself version-stamped (ansys241.exe for 2024 R1, etc.) under a v<ver> root (v231/v241/...). REQUIRES Python + uv on PATH and a host Ansys MAPDL install — the MAPDL-launching tools (launch_mapdl_session / connect_to_mapdl / disconnect_from_mapdl) start or attach to the solver and run arbitrary APDL, so the operator gates those raw solver/run tools behind consent the same way as any code-exec surface (D-4). Windows + Ansys MAPDL desktop only in this probe.

entries.name: KiCad MCP server
entries.summary: Drive KiCad EDA from an AI client — PCB design, DRC, simulation, BOM, DFM, manufacturing — through kicad-cli and the KiCad IPC / SWIG scripting API. Community server oaslananka/kicad-mcp (Python), published to PyPI as kicad-mcp-pro, pinned to v3.14.1 and run via uvx with the version pinned in --from (vendored_source block, community fork, MIT). PRIVACY: telemetry is OFF by default (OTLP export is opt-in to an operator-supplied collector), no telemetry-disable env needed. SAFETY: remote tools are read-only by default; destructive operations (board/schematic writes, manufacturing output) require explicit operator consent. disabled-until-probe: enables when uvx is on PATH AND a host KiCad 10.x install is detected via the glob C:\Program Files\KiCad\1[0-9]*\bin\kicad-cli.exe — per the server's compatibility.yaml, kicad-mcp-pro v3.14.1 targets KiCad 10.0.x as the PRIMARY supported line (KiCad 9.x was dropped/EOL after 10.0.0; 8.x is deprecated file-level-only; 7.x unsupported), so the gate matches the 10.x-and-newer roots only. REQUIRES Python 3.13+ and uv on PATH, plus a host KiCad 10.x install. Windows + KiCad desktop only in this probe.
